stories.title: New York Times: 12 doden bij aanval luchthaven Riyad

en.title: New York Times: 12 dead in attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: At least 12 people were killed and around 50 wounded in attacks on Riyadh's international airport. Officials report this is the deadliest attack in a Gulf state since the US-Israel conflict with Iran began in February.

stories.title: Tientallen gewonden na aanval op luchthaven Riyad, VS overweegt in te grijpen

en.title: Dozens wounded in attack on Riyadh airport, US considers intervention
en.summary: A major attack on Riyadh's international airport on Saturday resulted in dozens of wounded. President Trump stated the US may support Saudi Arabia with operations against Houthi forces.

stories.title: Verhoudingen VS-Oekraïne opnieuw gespannen na dieseldeal. Trump: ‘Tijd dat Oekraïne nieuwe president krijgt’

en.title: US-Ukraine relations tense again after diesel deal. Trump: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president'
en.summary: Relations between the US and Ukraine have become strained following a diesel transaction. Trump has suggested Ukraine needs new leadership to negotiate peace with Russia.

stories.title: Trump haalt uit naar Zelensky: 'Tijd voor nieuwe president die deal kan sluiten'

en.title: Trump attacks Zelensky: 'Time for new president who can make a deal'
en.summary: President Trump criticized Ukrainian President Zelensky, stating Ukraine needs different leadership capable of negotiating an end to the war with Russia. Trump has previously opposed Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil facilities.

stories.title: Tot zeker zondagavond geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft na brandstichting

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft until at least Sunday evening after arson attack
en.summary: Train service between Rotterdam and Delft is suspended until Sunday evening following an arson attack on a railway bridge in Delfhaven. ProRail does not rule out sabotage and estimates repairs will take until at least Sunday, possibly extending into Monday morning.

stories.title: Nog het hele weekend geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft na brandstichting bij spoorbrug

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft throughout the weekend after arson at railway bridge
en.summary: Train service between Rotterdam and Delft is disrupted for the entire weekend due to an arson incident at a railway bridge.

stories.title: Zeker tot zondagavond geen treinen tussen Rotterdam en Delft na brandstichting

en.title: No trains between Rotterdam and Delft until at least Sunday evening after arson attack
en.summary: Trains on the Rotterdam to Delft route will resume at the earliest on Sunday evening. ProRail initially expected to resolve the issue Saturday evening but confirmed the damage resulted from intentional arson.

stories.title: Christa Pike terug in gevangenis, maar krijgt nog wel medische zorg

en.title: Christa Pike returned to prison but continues to receive medical care
en.summary: Christa Pike, a 50-year-old inmate, has been discharged from hospital and returned to prison one and a half weeks after a failed execution attempt in Tennessee. She will continue receiving medical care in prison while her recovery is monitored.

stories.title: Gewonden bij aanval op luchthaven in Saudische hoofdstad Riyad, vliegverkeer ligt stil

en.title: Wounded in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh, flight traffic halted
en.summary: An unknown number of people were injured in attacks on Riyadh's international airport, with a rocket hitting a passenger terminal. All flights to and from King Khalid International Airport have been suspended and the airport evacuated.

stories.title: Christa Pike tien dagen na mislukte executie terug naar gevangenis gebracht

en.title: Christa Pike returned to prison ten days after failed execution
en.summary: American woman Christa Pike, who survived an execution attempt in late September, was discharged from the hospital and returned to prison where she has spent the past thirty years.

stories.title: Luchthaven Riyad geëvacueerd na raketaanval Houthi’s, tientallen gewonden

en.title: Riyadh airport evacuated after Houthi rocket attack, dozens wounded
en.summary: Riyadh airport was evacuated following a rocket attack by Houthi forces, resulting in dozens of casualties.

stories.title: Geen treinverkeer op spoor tussen Rotterdam en Delft door brandstichting

en.title: No train traffic on track between Rotterdam and Delft due to arson
en.summary: A fire at a railroad bridge halted train service between Rotterdam Centraal and Delft Campus throughout Saturday, with authorities finding no immediate connection to recent rail sabotage incidents.
